manual_discovery_ip_addresses.label: Manual device addresses (IP or description URL)
manual_discovery_ip_addresses.description: If a device is not discovered automatically, add it manually using its IPv4 address (e.g. 192.168.1.50) or, if the device does not respond to that, the full description URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080/description.xml).

replace_pause_with_stop.label: Replace Pause with Stop
replace_pause_with_stop.description: Forces Music Assistant to stop playback instead of pausing. Enable for some legacy streamers which are unable to pause/resume playback when streaming uPnP/DLNA.

requires_fixed_content_length.description: Enable this if the player needs to know the length of a track: it stops or loops during playback, or its own pause and seek do not work. With WAV as output codec and flow mode and crossfade disabled, a track is then sent as a file the player can pause, resume and seek in by itself. Most players play fine without it.

manifest.description: Stream music to supported UPnP/DLNA-compatible devices.
